questions.title: Scalar Subquery Shape
questions.description: What does a scalar subquery return?

questions.title: Where Scalar Fits
questions.description: Where can a scalar subquery legally appear?
questions.Option3: In WHERE, HAVING and SELECT comparisons

questions.title: EXISTS Meaning
questions.description: WHERE EXISTS (subquery) is true when:
questions.Option1: The subquery returns exactly one row
questions.Option4: The subquery returns at least one row

questions.title: IN Versus Equals
questions.description: Which operator tests a column against a LIST of values produced by a subquery?

questions.title: Correlated Subquery Definition
questions.description: What makes a subquery 'correlated'?
questions.Option1: It runs once for the whole query
questions.Option2: It references outer-query columns and is re-evaluated per outer row

questions.title: Derived Table Alias
questions.description: A subquery in FROM (a derived table):
questions.Option1: Needs an alias in most dialects (SQLite makes it optional, but always give one)
questions.Option3: Cannot be joined to other tables

questions.title: Select One Practice Snippet
questions.description: Why do EXISTS subqueries conventionally use SELECT 1?
questions.Option2: The selected value is ignored — EXISTS only checks row existence

questions.title: NOT IN Empty Subquery
questions.description: x NOT IN (subquery that returns zero rows) evaluates to:

questions.title: AVG Subquery Comparison
questions.description: price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM properties) finds:
questions.Option4: Properties priced above the overall average

questions.title: Subquery In SELECT List
questions.description: Placing (SELECT MAX(price) FROM properties) in the SELECT list of a 10-row query produces:
questions.Option1: The same value repeated on every row
questions.Option4: An error — subqueries only work in WHERE

questions.title: NOT IN NULL Trap
questions.description: NOT IN compares against a subquery result that contains a NULL. What happens?
questions.Option2: No rows are returned at all

questions.title: Correlated Count Snippet
questions.description: What does this query return?
questions.Option4: One row per agent with their listing count (zero included)
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT a.name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM properties p
   WHERE p.agent_id = a.id) AS listings
FROM agents a;

questions.title: EXISTS Versus IN
questions.description: For 'agents with at least one listing', why is EXISTS often preferred over IN?
questions.Option2: EXISTS scans the whole subquery first
questions.Option3: EXISTS can stop at the first matching row and dodges NULL membership pitfalls

questions.title: Subquery In FROM Alias Snippet
questions.description: In this query, what is d?
questions.Option3: The alias of the derived table (subquery) in FROM

questions.title: Rewriting ALL
questions.description: SQLite has no ALL keyword. How can x > ALL (subquery) be expressed?

questions.title: Scalar In Select Header Snippet
questions.description: What does the market_avg column look like in the output?
questions.Option2: The same value on every row

questions.title: Nested Scalar Subqueries Snippet
questions.description: What does this query return?
questions.Option1: The most expensive listing in each city
questions.Option4: An error — p is out of scope

questions.title: Double NOT IN Danger
questions.description: Two chained NOT IN filters where the inner subquery can contain NULL. Why is this risky?
questions.Option2: A single NULL makes the NOT IN comparison unknown, silently returning no rows

questions.title: EXISTS Empty Set Behaviour
questions.description: WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM properties WHERE 1 = 0) evaluates to:
questions.Option3: True for every outer row — NOT EXISTS of an empty set is true

questions.title: Derived Then Filtered Snippet
questions.description: What does this query return?
questions.Option4: Only agents holding more than one property
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT d.agent_id, d.listings
FROM (SELECT agent_id, COUNT(*) AS listings
      FROM properties GROUP BY agent_id) d
WHERE d.listings > 1;
